gen-gf-unkempt-gf-hanken-grotesk: Expressive and a bit rough-hewn, Unkempt looks bent from wire, its t crossbar as heavy as its stem. Hanken Grotesk is the modern sans underneath, and a slightly larger size for it would give those wide channels room.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-host-grotesk: Commanding in a hand-cut way, Unkempt gives every stroke a pipe-like body, with gaps that keep its c from closing into an o. Host Grotesk, a plain sans, sweeps open beside it.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-hubot-sans: Unkempt has no hairlines at all, so every stem matches every connecting stroke and the heading looks cut with one tool. Hubot Sans does the opposite job, keeping its e opened wide for text that moves along easily.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: Expressive and blunt, Unkempt looks cut from strips of equal width, with a t whose crossbar matches its stem. IBM Plex Sans Arabic follows in a plain sans, its apertures open, so the loud heading never crowds the text.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devanaga: Commanding and unmodulated, Unkempt has no calligraphic contrast, just strokes of matching weight and a c that stays distinct from o. IBM Plex Sans Devanagari loosens things below with rope-like curves that never knot at the ends.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: Open, uncrowded mouths on the s and c make IBM Plex Sans Hebrew easy going, a plain sans with a contemporary feel. Unkempt then adds a heading of identical bar thickness across the line, which gives the pairing its punch.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: Expressive and forceful, Unkempt never thins its strokes. IBM Plex Sans JP, a sans-serif, ends each curve in a clean, open gap, so a longer stretch of it reads steadily and without strain.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: IBM Plex Sans KR is a plain sans with openness at every curve end, set against a heading whose curves never thin at the shoulders. Reading a longer passage feels smooth.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: IBM Plex Sans Thai sets the c's two ends pointing apart like open pincers, a modern sans with a quiet manner. Unkempt does best at signage-like plainness in every line weight, while IBM Plex Sans Thai does best at staying open and easy to follow.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-loo: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped reads clean and neutral, a sans whose curves refuse to close. Unkempt does its best work at bold, hairline-free shapes, while the body font keeps text calm.
